{{Quote|I wasn't born on this mudball, friend Dhur. One of my instructors was a professor at CU's School of Music. I went to visit him from time to time.|Zan Yant|<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>}}
The '''School of Music''' was a branch of the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant]], located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], that was devoted to the study and performance of [[Music/Legends|music]].<ref name="MedStar I" />
